strings: Vinciane Vinckenbosch is a multilingual website project for a violist, combining an elegant public showcase with a Sanity administration studio for content, media, agenda, translations, and press documents.

A multilingual website project for violist Vinciane Vinckenbosch, combining an elegant public showcase with an administration studio for managing content, media, concerts, translated texts, and press materials.

The build brings together a performance-focused Astro front end, Vue interaction layers, Sanity content modelling, responsive media handling, and Vercel deployment for a polished multilingual artist platform.
The interface is designed to feel refined and precise, while the CMS structure keeps the editorial workflow clear across French, English, and German.

The black of a concert hall at night. An audience held in silence, in shadow. A single white light finds the stage — sharp, absolute — the soloist at its centre. And the warm amber of the palette echoes the viola itself: ancient wood, resonant grain, the body of sound.
